top_choice_rationale: P002 pairs the best-attributed and most mature advance, general ligand-controlled Pd-catalysed C-N cross-coupling (Buchwald, Hartwig; a bond type the 2010 prize left out), with base editing (Liu), deaminase chemistry on single nucleotides that changed what researchers and clinicians can do and is already in patients. Liu alone is an imperfect credit that omits Komor and Gaudelli, and base editing follows the 2020 CRISPR prize closely, so P001 is a close second as the safest single part; P003 is a conceptually strong but less mature case, with contested physiological relevance of condensates.
